Name: Rocks drop ores
Author: FastestBoi
Description:
[size=5]Description:
[/size]
[b]While mining to find the next ladder, we sometimes waste a lot of valuable time. With this mod, there is a small chance to get ores(coal, copper, iron, gold) from mining rocks. Ores can be found according to the floors. Here are some details:[/b]

- New stones with the same texture as the game's are added
- Frequency of encountering these new rocks is: 50%

Drop rates board: 
[spoiler]
- Type 1-2   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] Floors  1-30    ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] 30% for 1 [color=#cccccc][b]coal[/b][/color]
- Type 3-4   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] Floors 30-40   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color] [/b]30% for 1-2 [b][color=#b6b6b6]coal[/color][/b], 10% for 1 [b][color=#ff7700]copper
[/color][/b]- Type 5-6   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] Floors 40-70   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] 10% for 1 [b][color=#b6b6b6]coal[/color][/b], 10% for 1 [b]iron
[/b]- Type 7-8   ﻿[color=#ff0000][b]|[/b][/color] Floors 70-80   ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] 20% for 1-2 [b]iron
[/b]- Type 9-10 ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] Floors 80-110 ﻿[color=#ff0000]| [/color]10% for 1 [color=#ffff00][b]gold
[/b][/color]- Type 11-12 ﻿[b][color=#ff0000]|[/color][/b] Floors 110-120 [color=#ff0000][b]|[/b][/color] 10% for 1-2 [color=#ffff00]gold[/color], 0.5% 1 [color=#ff00ff][b]iridium[/b][/color]
[/spoiler]

[size=5]Known Issues:
[/size]Rarely, no ladder can be found on a floor. re-enter to regenerate the floor.
